steps.note: Skimmed milk and cream are mixed to the fat and solids of the recipe, and vegetable oils are added.
The base is concentrated in a falling-film evaporator.

steps.what: demineralised whey powder and whey proteins
steps.note: They are dissolved in a turbomixer to 40-45 % dry matter, then vitamins, calcium and trace minerals are stirred in.
The mix is heated again, with no holding time.
It is spray dried in a tower with hot air, and the powder is dry blended with glucose and packed under nitrogen.

sources.text: The order of the steps and their figures are from the patent's worked example, one maker's route; the handbook and the supplier page confirm that 90 % demineralised whey goes into infant formula, wet or dry blended.
